Business expenses > Travel and meals

Book standard-class rail travel. A business-trip evening meal may be claimed up to £30 per person, including service charges. Alcohol is not reimbursed. Q21.answer: The HR policies state that expense claims must be submitted **within 30 calendar days of the purchase date**[expenses#eligibility-and-submission].
Q21.context:
<excerpt id="expenses#eligibility-and-submission" document="Business expenses" doc_id="NS-EXPENSES" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Business expenses > Eligibility and submission

Employees may claim reasonable, necessary business expenses through SpendTrack. Submit claims within 30 calendar days of the purchase date. Attach an itemised receipt and state the business purpose. A missing receipt requires written approval from Finance before submission; a bank statement alone is not an itemised receipt.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="expenses#approval-and-payment" document="Business expenses" doc_id="NS-EXPENSES" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Business expenses > Approval and payment

Your line manager approves claims up to and including £500. Claims above £500 also need Finance approval from Daniel Reed. Approved claims are paid in the next Friday payment run if Finance receives them by Tuesday at 12:00; later claims move to the following Friday. This policy cannot show whether an individual payment has been made.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="expenses#home-office-purchases" document="Business expenses" doc_id="NS-EXPENSES" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Business expenses > Home-office purchases

Apply the eligibility, approval and £150 annual limit in the remote working policy before submitting a home-office claim. The £30 meal limit does not apply to home-office equipment. Purchases without the required advance approval are referred to Finance for review; payment is not guaranteed.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="onboarding#first-week" document="New starter onboarding" doc_id="NS-ONBOARDING" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
New starter onboarding > First week

Complete information security and code of conduct training within 5 working days of starting. Your line manager agrees your first-month goals by the end of working day 5. Read the annual leave, sickness absence and expenses policies before making related requests or claims.
</excerpt>

judge.rationale: The answer correctly identifies the 30-day deadline and cites the correct excerpt, but it is incomplete as it omits the required submission method (SpendTrack) and supporting documentation (itemised receipt and business purpose) included in the reference answer.
